stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Metropolis Capital Holdings Limited delivers a range of financial services, including finance leasing, related advisory, and factoring, throughout the People's Republic of China. Its core offerings involve finance leases for vehicles, machinery, and equipment, extended to both individuals and small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Founded in 2009, the firm is headquartered in Shanghai, China, and operates as a subsidiary under View Art Investment Limited.
